content.text:
Sorry — I can’t run continuous background checks or send pings after this chat ends.

If you want the same behavior yourself, run a small monitoring tool on your machine or a cloud server. Below is a concise Python script that polls a URL every N minutes, detects content changes, and emails you when the status changes. Save it as monitor.py, fill in the variables, and run it (or set it up as a service/cron job).

Python script (requires requests):
```
import time, requests, smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
STATE_FILE = "last_state.txt"

# Configure:
URL = "https://example.com/status"   # URL to check
INTERVAL_MIN = 5                     # minutes between checks
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example.com"
SMTP_PORT = 587
SMTP_USER = "you@example.com"
SMTP_PASS = "your-smtp-password"
TO_EMAIL = "your@example.com"
FROM_EMAIL = SMTP_USER

def send_email(subject, body):
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = FROM_EMAIL
    msg["To"] = TO_EMAIL
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS)
        s.send_message(msg)

def load_last():
    try:
        return open(STATE_FILE, "rb").read()
    except:
        return b""

def save_last(data):
    with open(STATE_FILE, "wb") as f:
        f.write(data)

while True:
    try:
        r = requests.get(URL, timeout=20)
        content = r.content
        last = load_last()
        if content != last:
            subject = f"Status changed for {URL} (HTTP {r.status_code})"
            body = f"URL: {URL}\nHTTP: {r.status_code}\n\nNew content (truncated):\n{content[:400]!s}"
            send_email(subject, body)
            save_last(content)
    except Exception as e:
        # optional: notify on repeated errors
        print("Check error:", e)
    time.sleep(INTERVAL_MIN * 60)
```

If you prefer, use a hosted monitor (UptimeRobot, Pingdom), an automation platform (IFTTT/Make/Zapier), or I can provide a variant that sends SMS, Slack, or Pushbullet notifications instead.
